[[Lieutenant]] [[Tallissan Lintra]] of the [[Resistance]] [[pilot]]ed a blue '''[[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]''' during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. It was destroyed when [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] attacked and destroyed other [[starfighter]]s in the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] during the [[Battle of Oetchi]]<ref name="Episode VIII" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tallissan Lintra's [[A-wing starfighter|A-wing's]] first appearance was in the first expansion pack for the 2017 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' where it introduced Tallie's A-Wing as a starfighter hero unit, the pack was released on [[December 13]], two days before the movie.<ref name="The Last Jedi Season">{{EA|url=games/starwars/battlefront/star-wars-battlefront-2/news/the-last-jedi-season-is-coming|text=Choose a Side: The Last Jedi Season Is Coming}}</ref>
